param: α₁ The proportion at which Susceptible people are recruited
α₂ The proportion at which infected people are recruited
ψ₁ The effective contact rate of infected humans leading to new infections
ψ₂ The contact rate of Ebola virus pathogens in the environment leading to new infections
ψ₃ The effective contact rate of deceased humans leading to new infections
ϵ Natural death rate of humans
ρ₁ Rate of death of human individuals due to infection
ρ₂ Rate at which infected humans shed virus into the environment
ρ₃ The rate at which infected people are quarantined
ω₁ The rate at which quarantined people recover
ω₂ The rate at which quarantined people die from the disease
h Proportion of shedding of deceased people into the environment
c The proportion rate of burial of deceased people
b The decay/removal rate of EVD in the environment
d Constant rate of environmental contamination (e.g., from infected bush meat)
